verdict.rationale: Penpot's docs promise open formats and no lock-in — the file format is open and design data can be inspected/exported as CSS, HTML, SVG and JSON, and self-hosting gives full data control (penpot-docs-21, penpot-docs-28, penpot-docs-38). However, a hands-on community report directly contradicts full-data export, stating the user 'had no way to export the diagram as one file like PDF or JPG. I could only export a layer' (penpot-comm-5), suggesting the practical export experience falls short of the 'export all my data and leave' promise. Missing for 10: independent confirmation of a full-project/all-files bulk export, verification that the open file format round-trips completely outside Penpot, and resolution of the community-reported export limitation.
